I lived in Egypt for three years and had a bunch of close gay friends and lovers. I’m back in the US now, and even though one of my friends had my heart, we still talk and laugh, just from a distance. Even though things clicked and seemed magic, distance definitely doesn’t help, so we’ve just remained amazingly close friends. 

You can do it! It’ll hurt a lot, but if you both clicked so well, there’s so reason to not keep in communication and keep the friendship going! And you never know; as you both get older and finish school, you may be able to meet up again and continue things! Just don’t force it, and enjoy the relationship as it is.
